items.description: Coverage information about dental procedures, frequency limitations, policy limitations, and percentages

copay.description: Copayment dollar amount for the procedure. Formated to 2 decimal places.

limitation_description.description: A detailed statement describing the conditions, constraints, or rules that limit how, when, or for whom this procedure code can be used. This may include specific eligibility requirements, coverage restrictions, frequency limits, age considerations, or any other applicable guidelines that affect the procedure's usage and reimbursement.

limitation_frequency.description: Description of the frequency of the limitation. Format must follow the pattern 'X per Y period' where X is a number, Y is a time period (e.g., months, years, lifetime), and may include modifiers such as 'consecutive', 'calendar', etc. Examples: '1 per 12 consecutive months', '2 per calendar year'. Pay attention to special modifiers such as '1 per 12 consecutive months' or '1 per 12 calendar months' please include the special modifier in the output. Additional examples of the special modifiers are 'consecutive', 'calendar', 'visit', 'date of service', 'provider', and more.

shares_frequency_with_procedure_codes.description: Comma-separated list of procedure codes (e.g., 'D0120, D0140, D0150') that share the same frequency limitation.

treatment_area.description: Specific dental area using standard notation (e.g., 'tooth 14', 'upper right quadrant', 'full mouth'). Use exact terminology from source document.

inn_ppo.description: INN PPO Network Percentage. Format is a percentage (e.g. 100 for 100%) so max is 100

inn_premier.description: INN Premier Network Percentage. Format is a percentage (e.g. 100 for 100%) so max is 100

oon_ppo.description: OON PPO Network Percentage. Format is a percentage (e.g. 100 for 100%) so max is 100

prior_auth.description: Set to true if there are prior authorization requirements for the procedure; false otherwise

procedure_code.description: The dental procedure code (e.g., D0120). When encountering code ranges (e.g., 'D2391-D2394'), expand into individual codes (D2391, D2392, D2393, D2394). For shorthand terms, map to their standard code (e.g., 'pano' becomes 'D0330').

procedure_deductible_applies.description: Whether the procedure has a deductible

procedure_name.description: Name or description of the dental procedure

procedure_waiting_period_duration.description: Waiting period duration for the procedure

categorized_services.description: Categorized services are services (OR Procedure Category) that are exactly matched to the names listed in the 'service_name' property enum. These services are extracted from the document and placed in the 'categorized_services' array.

service_deductible_applies.description: Set to true if the service has a deductible; false otherwise
